member.name: T:ReadyM.Modloader.Assemblies.LoadedAssemblies
member.summary: The already-loaded assembly a load context's unresolved reference binds to, before anything is probed on disk.
member.remarks: ONLY THE CONTEXT'S OWN. A hot-reloaded client gives each generation of its mods a load context of its own and never collects the earlier ones, so "loaded anywhere in the process" includes every earlier generation's copy of the same assembly. Binding to one of those hands the new mods types that merely share a name with their own. The default context needs no searching here: the runtime has already tried it before asking.
